title: Undicesimo, Prima e Dopo
label: ch:it-ordinali-esimo
canDo: I can build any ordinal above ten with -esimo, put two things in order with prima and dopo, and lay out the courses of a meal in sequence.

payoff.summary: The ordinals and prima/dopo used on the same four things, so the difference between naming a place and naming a relation is worked rather than stated.
